title: Does a compiler signature from a workflow_dispatch run on main meet ST-DIS-INV11?
description: ST-DIS-INV11 says that a compiler signature comes only from the signing job of a successful build on a push to main. The signing job in compiler-artifact.yml signs on any event on refs/heads/main that is not a pull request, so it also signs on workflow_dispatch. select_run in qualify-compiler-release.py accepts push and workflow_dispatch. The released compiler of 94d285d7 was signed by run 36128796855, a workflow_dispatch run on main. Option A: INV11 admits workflow_dispatch on main, because the dispatch builds the same commit of main with the same workflow and signer identity. Option B: INV11 stays as it is, the signing job refuses workflow_dispatch, and qualification refuses a signature from it; the releases signed by dispatch runs then do not meet INV11.
